# cidaas_notification_service_setup (Resource)

`cidaas_notification_service_setup` manages a communication provider service setup (an email/sms/ivr/push provider connection) via `notifications-srv`. Pair with `cidaas_notification_provider_config` for the actual credentials. `status` is verified manually in the cidaas service-desk UI and is not driven by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cidaas_notification_service_setup" "ses_email" {
  name                  = "SES Email"
  service_id            = "custom-ses-email"
  communication_methods = ["email"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `communication_methods` (Set of String) Communication methods handled by this setup: `email`, `sms`, `ivr`, `push`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the service setup.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID, e.g. `custom-ses-email`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `has_remote_templates` (Boolean) Whether templates for this setup are managed remotely.
- `parent_service_setup_id` (String) Parent service setup ID. Omit to let the platform auto-fill it when applicable; the value is stored after create/refresh.
- `service_category` (String) Service category.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service setup ID, assigned by the API.
- `status` (String) Setup status (`in-progress`, `active`, `inactive`). Verify manually in the cidaas service-desk to move it from `in-progress` to `active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cidaas_notification_service_setup.ses_email b4ba52ae-87b3-4967-93b6-8e6ae8f39922
```
